metric: unique-query population Q95 (single pass, NOT episode mean)

metric_definitions.population: every unique query_hash of the derived cache, one pass, no support sampling and no episode structure

estimators.ours_k0: our seed-42 baseline checkpoint, zero-shot, read from the export written by scripts/export_source_predictions.py
estimators.price_k0: the provided PRICE weights, zero-shot, no adaptation
estimators.pg: raw PostgreSQL estimate in the cache (cards[:, 1])

price.maxima_rule: elementwise max of inspection.max_counts over the compared databases, the same rule the source-side PRICE baseline used
price.decoding: price_log_predictions(): native output is log1p(card)+1, decoded to log(card)
price.adaptation: none (K=0, no support, no inner steps)

comparability.comparable_to: the ours_k0 / price_k0 / pg numbers inside this report, which share one query population and one metric definition
not_comparable_to: results/price-lr-search-result.json per_db_mean_q95, which is an episode mean over 64-query episodes
the PRICE figures quoted in docs 14 and 94, which are also episode-granular
comparability.reason: an episode mean of 64-query Q95s and a single-pass population Q95 measure different things; quoting them side by side would compare unlike units
